frequency_verified_scope: Observed only: three analyser OBW-centre readings were -1.829 / -4.767 / -0.262 kHz (mean -2.29 kHz, peak-to-peak 4.5 kHz). This is the scatter of the estimator on this signal, NOT a calibrated accuracy bound; the analyser frequency reference is uncalibrated and board-versus-instrument contributions cannot be separated.
occupancy_bandwidth_note: Three modulations agree with the digital computation within 1.08%. Theory Rs*(1+beta)=324 kHz is the SUPPORT; the 99% containment is 279,998 Hz.
methodology_notes: 对调制信号，Peak Search 给出的是带内随机最高点，不是中心频率；中心频率须用谱质心或 99% OBW 中点。16QAM 实测 Marker 落在 2.450875000 GHz，偏中心 -85 kHz。
频谱仪不能区分 BPSK/QPSK/16QAM：三者占用带宽同为 324 kHz，区别在相位结构；必须接收 IQ 后做星座/AI。
包顶 dBm 是带内功率密度（受 RBW 影响），不等于信号平均功率，不能用来排序三类调制的平均功率。
A digital-amplitude step is a cleaner known power change than an attenuator: no tolerance and no frequency response, and it is exactly computable from the bytes.

A damage threshold is not a usability criterion. docs/design/two-board-rf-link.md already forbade using the 2.5 dBm absolute max as a recommended target; EXP-TX-002 violated that and the violation went unnoticed until review.

marker_grid_retraction: The +2.5 kHz LO-offset claim is RETRACTED. The tone photos used span 10 MHz with 801 points = 12.5 kHz marker grid; +/-960 kHz is +/-76.8 grid steps, so the analyser displays +/-962.5 kHz and a 1.925 MHz separation even with ZERO LO offset. Reproduced by experiments/p13_marker_grid_analysis.py. Frequency resolution of those photos is +/-6.25 kHz (+/-2.6 ppm), not 1 ppm.
